title: Controls move the wrong way
backstory: After a control panel swap, every player notices the spider moves backwards. Rolling the ball up makes it go down and right makes it go left.
visible_effect: Dragging the trackball pad sends negated dx/dy to MAME — the spider moves in the opposite direction
diagnosis_hint: Failed quadrature phase (A/B swap) reverses perceived direction. Most likely the encoder connector was re-seated 180 degrees out after the panel swap. Try flipping the harness connector on the trackball PCB.
